observations.body: Sabbath includes household, servants, animals, and resident stranger; its stated reason is Israel’s slavery in Egypt and deliverance by the LORD’s strong hand.
observations.label: Sabbath is grounded in remembered slavery and release

observations.body: Sabbath is grounded in remembered slavery and release belongs to sinai remembered in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Deuteronomy 5:12–15 supplies later-memory evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: Within the Sinai event

observations.body: Later witnesses select and reuse Sinai in their own settings; they remain later readings rather than replacements for the Exodus event.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Deuteronomy 5:12–15 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Sabbath is grounded in remembered slavery and release belongs to the sinai remembered movement, but its part in the event must remain distinct from the surrounding speech, response, breach, and renewal.
payload.title: Sabbath is grounded in remembered slavery and release
